name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-hurt-death-block
title: Redrawn Styled Hurt/Death Block
description:
A redrawn styled death block useful for signaling a hurting block. It acts as 12F (the piranha plant act as that hurts the player) but you can set it as 130, 25 or whatever you want.

It uses only 3 tiles from BG3 so probably won't take up much slot, and uses the blank part of palette row 7 (along with black and white used colors).

You can also use this graphic for custom blocks like this and this.
